headline: Parking expansion at 100 Larrabee Road, a proposed rule on social amenities, and a workshop on replacing a fire-damaged home at 23 Locust Street.
summary: 100 Larrabee, LLC asks to add 24 parking spaces to the Larrabee Complex. Anania Development, LLC plans to demolish a 1895 two-family home at 23 Locust Street and build a new two-story, two-family home with two three-bedroom units.
items: Site plan to add 24 parking spaces at 100 Larrabee Road
Land use ordinance amendment on social engagement amenities in subdivision review
Workshop on replacing a fire-damaged 1895 two-family home at 23 Locust Street
location: Westbrook High School – Room 114, 125 Stroudwater Street
plain_text:
Page 1 of 1
Westbrook Planning Board
Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
Westbrook High School – Room 114
125 Stroudwater Street
This meeting will be offered as a hybrid meeting, accommodating both in-person and remote participation.
Where public comment is permitted, members of the public attending remotely will have the opportunity to
provide remote oral testimony. If you wish to speak during a Public Hearing or Public Comment, use the “Raise
Hand” function through Zoom (or dial *9 on your phone) when instructed by the Planning Board chair.
Zoom Link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/81700741385
Dial-in (audio only): 1-646-558-8656 Webinar ID: 817 0074 1385
AGENDA
1. Call to Order
2. Minutes
NEW BUSINESS
3. 26-000635 – Site Plan – 100 Larrabee Road – 100 Larrabee, LLC: The applicant is requesting an expansion 
to provide 24 additional parking spaces to the Larrabee Complex. Tax Map: 042B Lot: 006 Zone: Gateway 
Commercial, Use: Retail, Restaurant Class 2 
4. 25-001050 – Land Use Ordinance Amendment §335-13.3.H Subdivision Review Additional 
Requirements: The proposed amendment provides standards for social engagement amenities to be 
included with building and site design through the subdivision review process. 
WORKSHOP
5. 26-001056 – Village Review Overlay Zone – 23 Locust Street – Anania Development, LLC: The applicant is 
proposing to demolish an existing 1895 two-family dwelling that sustained fire-damage and construct a 
new two-story, two -family dwelling consisting of two three-bedroom units. Tax Map: 040, Lot: 188, Zone: 
City Center District & Village Review Overlay Zone, Use: Dwelling, Two-Family
